text: We got in on a Friday night, but wait was long. The kitchen was clearly in over its head. If you do go in you'll get a decent meal, but you'll also have to put up with that slow service. You can get the same result at a bunch of other places around town, and the good stuff here is just too easy to get at the bad. I'd rather eat somewhere that gets both right. Baan Noi will run you around $22 a head, but for what you get it's fair. Order the pad see ew. It has good texture and the noodles actually taste like something. Don't bother with the green curry. They load it down with sugar and it ends up cloying. That's not the only thing that dragged the meal down.
